items.question: Which additional ritual substances are prescribed in this sequence of offerings?
premises: Karavīra is specified as a ritual substance.
Arka is specified as a ritual substance.
Dhātrī fruit is likewise included as a substance.
items.inference: These substances are prescribed together as part of the ritual procedure.
uncertainties: The exact botanical identification implied by vārkeṇa is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: With oleander, with arka, and likewise with emblic fruit.
